sections.title: Stars and bars
facts: $n$ identical things into $k$ different boxes, empty allowed: $\binom{n + k - 1}{k - 1}$.
At least one in each box: $\binom{n - 1}{k - 1}$ (hand out one each first).
The things must be identical and the boxes different.

sections.title: Inclusion–exclusion
facts: Three sets: add the singles, take away the pairs, add back the triple.
Divisible by $a$ and $b$ means divisible by $\text{lcm}(a, b)$.

sections.title: Probability
facts: $P = \frac{\text{good outcomes}}{\text{all outcomes}}$ when outcomes are equally likely.
Two dice: $36$ ordered pairs; sum $s$ happens $6 - |s - 7|$ times.

sections.title: Geometric probability
facts: Two random numbers in $[0, 1]$ make a random point in the unit square.
Areas scale with the square: radius $r$ inside radius $R$ gives $\frac{r^2}{R^2}$.

sections.title: Expected value
facts: Expected values add: $n$ dice average $\frac{7n}{2}$ in total.
Waiting for something with chance $p$ each try takes $\frac{1}{p}$ tries on average.
